authority: Alex: current-turn cold-start session authorization; power off >=30 seconds

calibration.scope: Emulator only; no measured physical spin-up or timing noise claim

choreography.start_prerequisite: Prove the selected bound D81 and AUTOBOOT.C65 remain available after power off. A pre-power-off RAM PRG upload is not a boot path. If unconfirmed, do not start the contact.

decision_table.tag0-or-inconsistent: Coverage/readpoint unresolved; no success or clock-validity claim.
decision_table.tag1-valid-time-mask-passes: Completion observed in N frames; price a separate repair card with historical command ordering and measured margin/cap. No repair or release approval from this diagnostic contact.
decision_table.tag2: Completion status fails the mask; retain raw bytes and attribute status, not a successful timing calibration.
decision_table.tag4-valid-time-cap-reached: No completion within the cap; deeper attribution, no automatic timeout enlargement.
decision_table.tag5: Clock not observed or lost; do not base the repair on FF83 at this read point.

record.retention: First success retained until first failure replaces it; first failure never overwritten. No read ordinal is recorded.

screen.derived_read: base=scr_base; logical bytes=cols_*rows_; transport rounded up to 16 bytes; validate 1<=cols<=80, 1<=rows<=25 and entire transport in ordinary RAM [0x0200,0x8000) before reading; otherwise stop without reading the surface

status: BOUND; NOT STARTED; POWER-CYCLE BOOT TRANSPORT UNCONFIRMED
time_units: Frames. No seconds conversion without the measured video/frame rate. Fuel is a bounded no-clock escape, never elapsed time.
